text:
Maria Chen: quick sync — launching a tiny seed pilot for our Private onboarding flow. want to A/B test outreach tone + qualification check. goal: 8–12 partners, 6-week pilot. looking for messaging variants, gating criteria, and success metrics. who can help draft and run the send?
Samir Patel: happy to lead the messaging split. i suggest 3 variants: short/direct, product-story, and partnership-focus. keep send windows next week. :calendar:
Ajay Rao: for gating, prefer a small tech checklist + strategic fit score. tech checklist: can run execs behind VPC, has infra owner, okay with logs/audit sampling. fit score: product-market fit signal (1-5), integrations needed (1-3), timeline urgency (1-3).
Lina Gomez: important to define feedback cadence. weekly async survey + 30-min sync at week 3 and week 6. also capture one prompt set and acceptance criteria for model regressions.
Kelsey (PM): metric ask — what counts as success? raw list: acceptance rate >= 20%, first-week usage >= 150 API calls per partner, NPS >= 7, at least 3 actionable bugs or UX items logged. ok?
Maria Chen: that looks good. quick note on volume — if acceptance < 20% we'll widen outreach. need draft copy ASAP. Samir — can you paste the variants here?
Samir Patel: sure. Variant A (short/direct):

Subject: Quick invite — pilot our private deployment for low-latency inference
Hi {{name}},
Were running a small pilot for Redwood Private to help teams move low-latency inference into a VPC/on‑prem setup. Would you be open to a 6-week trial with dedicated ops support?
Best,
Samir

Variant B (product-story):

Subject: Cut inference cost and latency — join a private preview
Hey {{name}},
Teams like yours are struggling with unpredictable latency and spiky costs. Were opening a 6-week private preview to test dedicated capacity, routing controls, and audit integrations. We provide onboarding + an ops SLA. Interested?
—Samir

Variant C (partnership-focus):

Subject: Partner preview — co-shape Redwood Private (limited seats)
Hi {{name}},
Were forming a small group of partners to co-design Redwood Private. Youll get priority capacity, roadmap input, and 1:1 support. In return we ask for regular feedback and a short case study. Want to talk?
Thanks,
Samir

Samir Patel: also DM script will be shorter; we only DM after no reply to email in 4 days.
Ajay Rao: on qualification — we should require a short onboarding tech call (30m) and a signed pilot agreement that covers data handling and rollback. makes it easier to scope infra.
Lina Gomez: for feedback capture: add a short GitHub issue template or linear ticket template for bugs + a tiny weekly form: 3 quick questions (latency ok?, quality regressions?, ops friction?).
Kelsey (PM): sample send plan: week 0 — seed 40 invites (mix of warm intros + cold), measure acceptance. week 1 — onboard accepted partners. week 2–6 — weekly check-ins + collect prompt set + weekly form. we need volunteers for outreach (copy + sending + tracking).
Maria Chen: volunteers: Ajay for infra gating + onboarding calls, Samir for messaging & send ops, Kelsey for tracking metrics and outreach schedule, Lina for feedback instruments. i will own partner comms and case-study asks.
ops-bot: docs: created -> https://redwood.internal/docs/seed-pilot-outreach (ops-bot)
Samir Patel: one implementation detail: tag each partner in our dashboard with cohort=seed-pilot and route telemetry to private sandbox. Ill add the tag mapping in the runbook.
Lina Gomez: quick risks: low acceptance, engineering ramp for private networking, legal review timeline. mitigation: keep intake narrow and pre-clear legal for data terms.
Kelsey (PM): next steps: 1) finalize email variants + subject by EOD tomorrow 2) create onboarding checklist in the doc 3) schedule the week0 send 4) assign tracking spreadsheet. i can create the calendar invite for kickoff — propose Mon 10am.
Maria Chen: perfect. if anyone has alternate subject lines or a tighter variant (e.g., emphasize security compliance), drop them here. otherwise well lock and send drafts to legal for a quick review. thanks all :zap:
Samir Patel: dropping 2 alt subjects quickly:
- "Private preview: low-latency inference for regulated apps"
- "Join 6-week pilot: dedicated capacity + compliance hooks"

Ajay Rao: ok to close this thread? moving to doc for the checklist.
Maria Chen: closing here — doc is the source of truth. tagging volunteers in the doc.
